description:

title: Data Analyst II - Operations
description:
About Signant Health
  
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Data Analyst II works with Client Services staff to process data changes upon request. The Data Analyst II is also responsible for delivering data transfers when needed. The Data Analyst II shows high attention to detail to ensure that data updates they conduct, as well as data transfers they output and deliver to our clients, are of the utmost quality.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function
  
  

* Demonstrates extreme attention to detail and organization in all aspects of work.
* Responsible for executing data changes per request, either through backend database scripts or with the use of validated in-house Data Solution Tools.
* Creates and executes Data Change Guides (DCGs) and determines corresponding risk/impact assessments.
* Creates DTS packages for imports into study databases.
* Writes and executes SQL queries against MS SQL Database to extract data for data transfers and reports.
* May be called upon to execute SAS queries against MS SQL Database to extract data for data transfers and reports.
* Delivers client-requested database transfer datasets upon request.
* Participates in meetings with appropriate Client Services and Technical Delivery team members as it relates to study implementation and maintenance.
* Follows Signant Health Standard Operating Procedures for data change management, data transfer verification, and risk/impact assessment documentation.
* Creates stored procedures to manipulate data for data-driven changes to IXR system functionality if needed.
* Monitors data collected across multiple databases when required.
* May be called upon to verify data change requests.
* May be called upon to verify content of client-requested database transfer datasets per approved Data Transfer specifications.
* Some data entry of data change requests may be required.
* Technical support after-hours, on-call time is required at set intervals.
* Participates in special data-related projects as needed.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  

* 2–4 years of experience working in a data-driven environment.
* In-depth working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), as well as Microsoft Windows and the suite of Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with standard data mining and data presentation techniques.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced work environment with minimal direct supervision.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to effectively document procedures, processes, and results.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, as interaction with team members occurs daily.
* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and multi-task in a fast-paced work environment.
* Very strong skills with Microsoft Office applications.
* Comfortable working with business users and technical teams.
* Ability to create and execute SQL queries is required.

**Desirable:**  

* Familiarity with the C# programming language is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Visual Basic is a plus.
* Familiarity with GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 is a plus.

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Salesforce Business Analyst
description:

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce professional to design and deliver scalable, secure, and user-friendly solutions for complex business requirements. In this role, you will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to translate requirements into effective declarative solutions across the Salesforce platform.

You will take ownership of advanced automation, security, and configuration while helping improve platform standards and reduce technical debt. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems and influencing the long-term evolution of a Salesforce environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement complex declarative solutions across multiple Salesforce objects and business processes.
* Build and maintain advanced Salesforce Flow orchestrations and reusable automation frameworks.
* Configure sophisticated sharing and security models, including organization-wide defaults, role hierarchies, sharing rules, permission sets, and access controls.
* Maintain clear traceability between business requirements, solution designs, and platform configurations.
* Create and maintain solution design documents and other technical documentation.
* Troubleshoot complex issues involving configurations, automations, data access, and user permissions.
* Support user acceptance testing, release planning, deployment readiness, and post-release validation.
* Conduct peer reviews of configuration and automation changes to promote quality and adherence to platform standards.
* Identify opportunities to simplify solutions, standardize processes, improve maintainability, and reduce technical debt.
* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, architects, administrators, and testing teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or another relevant field.
* Five to seven years of hands-on Salesforce configuration and implementation experience.
* Current Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.

* Experience delivering declarative solutions across multiple objects and integrated business processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to review configurations critically and recommend scalable, maintainable solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator credential.
* Experience designing complex Flow orchestration and reusable automation frameworks.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale Salesforce environments with multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* Knowledge of Salesforce release management, deployment practices, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience establishing configuration standards, governance controls, and technical-debt reduction initiatives.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods and working with geographically distributed teams.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

title: Associate Data Analyst
description:

The Associate Data Analyst provides entry-level analytical, reporting, and operational support to help teams maintain accurate data, produce routine insights, and execute well-defined business processes. This role applies foundational data analysis concepts, follows established procedures, and partners with internal stakeholders to validate information, identify discrepancies, support reporting requests, and escalate non-routine issues as appropriate. * Perform data entry, maintenance, validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance activities across business systems, reports, and data sources.
* Review information for accuracy, identify discrepancies, conduct routine research, and coordinate resolution with appropriate stakeholders.
* Assist with the preparation, distribution, and maintenance of reports, dashboards, analyses, presentations, business documentation, and operational metrics.
* Support descriptive and diagnostic analysis by summarizing trends, patterns, variances, and data quality issues using readily available information.
* Follow documented procedures for testing, validating, updating, and documenting reports, data files, and recurring processes.
* Monitor shared work queues, reporting requests, data issues, and routine inquiries; respond to, route, or escalate items as appropriate.
* Maintain records, files, documentation, and system data in accordance with company policies, procedures, data governance standards, and applicable requirements.
* Build effective working relationships within the team and with internal stakeholders while learning business processes, systems, and reporting standards.
* Performs other duties as assigned

* Bachelor's Degree required

**Experience Qualifications**

* Typically < 2 years in data analysis, reporting, business analytics, business operations or related field required
* Demonstrated experience in risk management/insurance preferred

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to communicate with employees and stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow defined processes and manage multiple routine priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to analyze routine data, identify discrepancies, and summarize findings clearly
* Ability to follow standard practices, procedures, and instructions while escalating exceptions appropriately
* A demonstrated commitment to high professional ethical standards and a diverse workplace
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with Excel-based reporting and data visualization tools preferred
* Foundational knowledge of data analysis, reporting concepts, data quality, and basic problem-solving methods.
* Exposure to SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Python, R, or similar tools preferred but not required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively within a team and across departments

title: Senior Data Surveillance Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. **About the Role**

We are seeking a Central Monitoring, Data Analysis to join our team. As a Central Monitoring, Data Analysis, you will lead centralized monitoring activities for global and complex clinical trials, ensuring the effective configuration, execution, and maintenance of Risk-Based Quality Management (RBQM) systems. This position plays a critical role in study execution, data accuracy, regulatory compliance, and driving innovation in clinical trial monitoring. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout.

Responsibilities include overseeing RBQM system configuration and execution, interpreting Key Risk Indicator (KRI) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) data, developing advanced data analyses using programming expertise, and leading process improvement initiatives. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing patient safety, optimizing trial performance, and delivering actionable insights. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Central Monitoring, Data Analysis can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research and data analytics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as a subject matter expert for the configuration, implementation, and execution of Central Monitoring RBQM systems across studies.
* Maintain Key Risk Indicator and Quality Tolerance Limit libraries within the RBQM platform to ensure standard deployment consistency and alignment with regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with functional and cross-functional stakeholders to develop configuration specifications for Central Monitoring in RBQM systems.
* Provide operational expertise, training, and guidance as a point of escalation for Central Monitoring issues related to RBQM systems.
* Conduct central monitoring reviews in support of study central monitors, interpreting and presenting KRI and KPI data with actionable insights.
* Leverage programming expertise in languages such as R, SQL, or SAS to develop custom analyses, automate workflows, and integrate data systems.
* Participate in ongoing improvements in standardizing technologies, systems, processes, and training materials that support Central Monitoring and RBQM.
* Represent Central Monitoring in process improvement initiatives and contribute to innovation in central monitoring capabilities through collaboration with cross-functional teams.

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring:**

* Technical expertise in database design, system configuration, and report development with experience managing RBQM systems or similar platforms.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or SAS, with the ability to develop scripts for data analysis, automation, and system integration.
* Strong analytical problem-solving and critical thinking abilities, with experience troubleshooting data refreshes and resolving execution errors in analytical systems.
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment.
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, with effective interpersonal skills.
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Comfort working with RBQM platforms, electronic data capture systems, and clinical databases.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience.
* Minimum 2 years of direct experience with RBQM systems or similar centralized monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP guidelines, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data manipulation and reporting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree in a related field such as Data Science, Biostatistics, or Clinical Research.
* Experience with CluePoints or similar centralized monitoring and risk-based quality management solutions.
* Experience in site monitoring, data management, or clinical operations.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and interpret business trends and apply them to centralized monitoring practices.
